images.title: Remo's reading back from 08:15 p.m.
images.purpose: A time line from 08:15 p.m. going back to 05:35 p.m. with a hop back of 2 hours, a hop back of 15 minutes and a hop back of 25 minutes.
images.composition: A caption at the top, a time line with its labelled ticks and curved hops above it, and the working written large at the bottom.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. TOP LEFT: the caption Remo finished reading at 08:15 p.m. after 2 hours 40 minutes in dark #1F2937 sans-serif bold (34 px), left edge at x 100, about y 70. TIME LINE: one thin dark #2B2B2B horizontal line (5 px) at y 430 from x 140 to x 1356, drawn at 7.6 px for each minute. TICKS: exactly 4 tall tick marks (44 px) at x 140, 330, 444, 1356, each with a round dot (24 px across): teal blue #0072B2 at x 140; grey #6B7280 at x 330; grey #6B7280 at x 444; amber #E69F00 at x 1356. TIME LABELS under the ticks, in dark #1F2937 bold (34 px): 05:35 p.m. centred at x 140, about y 505; 06:00 p.m. centred at x 330, about y 505; 06:15 p.m. centred at x 444, about y 565; 08:15 p.m. centred at x 1356, about y 505. There are no other ticks and no other labels on the line. HOPS: exactly 3 curved arrows above the line, each a smooth arc (the top of an ellipse) with its arrowhead at the left end, landing on the line: hop 1 is teal blue #0072B2 (6 px), from x 1356 to x 444 (912 px wide, 110 px high), label back 2 hours centred above it; hop 2 is amber #E69F00 (6 px), from x 444 to x 330 (114 px wide, 50 px high), label back 15 / minutes centred above it; hop 3 is reddish purple #CC79A7 (6 px), from x 330 to x 140 (190 px wide, 70 px high), label back 25 / minutes centred above it. Where a time label sits on the lower row (about y 565), a thin grey #6B7280 leader line (2 px) joins it to its tick. BOTTOM: centred at x 728 and about y 700, one line of bold dark text, 08:15 p.m. − 2 hours 40 minutes = 05:35 p.m. (48 px), the largest text in the frame. Nothing else in the frame.
labels: Remo finished reading at 08:15 p.m. after 2 hours 40 minutes
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
more or fewer than 4 labelled ticks or 3 hop arrows, arrowheads at the right ends, or hop widths that are not in proportion to 120, 15 and 25 minutes (912, 114 and 190 px)
images.takeaway: Go back the hours first, 08:15 p.m. to 06:15 p.m., then 15 minutes back to 06:00 p.m., then the 25 minutes left: 05:35 p.m.
images.description: A time line from 08:15 p.m. going back to 05:35 p.m. with a hop back of 2 hours, a hop back of 15 minutes and a hop back of 25 minutes.
images.context: Concept image for Time Before. It follows the idea of the hops in your maths book (the time before a time found by hopping back the hours and then the minutes) and shows the concept's own example of Remo reading.
images.teaching_notes: Go back the hours first, then back to the whole hour, then the minutes left. The slip to watch: taking 40 minutes away from 08:15 as if it were 08:15 minus 15.

image_decisions.why: The time line with hops going back shows the same strategy the other way round.
